scope: Original-byte preservation, retained stored-union inclusion and a bounded historical symbol-freshness search. No corpus adoption or semantic/real-extent/runtime acceptance.

legacy_source.artifact_paths: All legacy_asm and legacy_c cells are relative to proof_root at this commit. They are adjacent paired path references, not paths in the Research repository.

retained_ownership_snapshot.scope: The published 20261104 stored-definition inventory; metadata ownership is not actual function extent.
retained_ownership_snapshot.range_convention: Eight-digit uppercase VA; half-open [start,stop); disjoint union ranges separated by semicolon.
retained_ownership_snapshot.missing_union_field: Empty means no exact stored definition. Numeric zero means every declared byte is present, not that the operation is complete.

bounded_name_observation_set.type: Reviewed finite actual successful analyst-name changes and exact-name readbacks; no fresh global DB name scan.
limits: The scanner excludes comments and literals; a hit may be a function definition or noncall use.
No hit is not a freshness guarantee; a hit is not an automatic new Native-read requirement.

research_canonical_join.limits: Snapshot paths/names for existing successors; presence does not close every historical operation, ABI or data dependency.

historical_reviewed_join_preserved.meaning: Earlier reviewed snapshot, retained as history. The separate 75-entry join was recomputed and happens to preserve the same intersection.

not_claimed: Semantic coverage or whole-game relevance disposition
Actual complete function extents from metadata, old windows, cap flags or terminal RET
Whole-corpus current naming, parameter/type/comment synchronization or indirect caller closure
Runtime behavior, database repair or automatic mass re-export
